email.advisor.portal-intro: Access the {{clientAcronym}} Advisor Portal to start a new application or take action on an application in progress:
email.advisor.purged-message: This incomplete application has expired and has been securely deleted. It can no longer be resumed.
email.purge.subject: Your insurance application progress
email.purge.intro: Your insurance application through {{associationName}} has expired and has been securely deleted in accordance with our data retention policy. Application data is saved for you for {{retentionDays}} days to complete until it is deleted.
email.purge.start-new: If you’d still like to apply, you can start a new application.
email.purge.questions: If you have questions about your insurance options, we’re happy to help and provide additional information.
email.purge.advisor-next-step: If you would still like to apply or have questions, please contact your advisor for assistance.
email.common.copy-address: Or copy and paste this website address into your browser:
email.common.closing: We look forward to serving your insurance needs.
email.common.identity-notice: To access your application information, you will be asked to verify your identity using the email and phone number provided in your application.
email.common.retention-title: Your application will be saved for {{retentionDays}} days.
email.common.retention-description: For your security, your saved application will be deleted on {{purgeDate}}. After that, you’ll need to begin a new application.
email.autosave.subject: Your insurance application is being saved
email.autosave.intro: Your insurance application through {{associationName}} has been automatically saved so you don’t lose your progress.
email.autosave.deadline: You can return to complete your application by {{purgeDate}}.
email.invitation.subject: Your insurance application is ready to complete and sign
email.invitation.intro: Your insurance application through {{associationName}} has been prepared and is ready to complete and sign.
email.invitation.deadline: Please complete the rest of your application by {{purgeDate}}.
email.pending.subject: Your insurance application is ready to be completed
email.pending.intro: We noticed you haven’t finished your {{associationName}} insurance application. Good news—your progress has been saved.
email.resume.subject: Your requested link to continue your application
email.resume.intro: A request has been made to return to an insurance application in progress through {{associationName}}. Click the link below to continue to your application.
email.resume.expiry: This link will expire in {{linkMinutes}} minutes.
email.resume.not-requested-description: If you did not request a link, you may ignore this message. Access to application information will only be granted with verification.
email.footer.no-reply: Please note: This is an automated message. Replies to this email are not monitored.
